citations.narrative:
The inventory for this current report is a total of 2,437 birds, upon review of the facility's license it is approved for up to
1300 animals. Licenses authorize increments of 50 animals on hand at any single point in time during the period of
licensure. A licensee must obtain a new license before any change resulting in more than the authorized number of
animals on hand at any single point in time during the period of licensure.
Correct by August 14, 2026.

The facility failed to maintain a primary enclosure that securely contained the birds. During the inspection, seven budgies
were observed on top of other cages outside of their primary enclosures. There weren’t any observable damage or
defects noted on the enclosures and facility representatives stated that the birds likely escaped when moving them to
another enclosure.
Birds that are not securely contained may be unable to readily access food and water, and may be more vulnerable to
injury, predation, or environmental hazards.
Primary enclosures must be constructed and maintained so that they securely contain the birds.
To be corrected by August 1, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
Additional Inspectors:
Michael Tygart, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER
CODY YAGER n
